title: EIP-8375: ePBS Mandatory Burn of Execution Rewards
description: Burns priority fees and targets external builder bids subject to a PTC-observed competitive floor.
author: Ben Adams (@benaadams)
laymanDescription: Only the base fee is burned today; priority fees and builder payments go to proposers, and rare jackpot slots make validator income wildly uneven. This proposal burns a fixed fraction of both, and has the payload timeliness committee publish the best public bids it saw so proposers cannot quietly accept a lowball one.
benefits: Burns a fixed share, so proposers cannot prefer payment over an equivalent burn
Priority-fee burn credits the builder's target rather than being charged twice
The floor is built from signed, collateralized public bids, not a subjective MEV oracle
Self-build pays the priority-fee burn, so it is not a zero-burn escape
tradeoffs: Not coalition-proof; value competitors cannot observe or price stays unburned
Proposer-authorized outsourced self-build becomes the main remaining avoidance route
Disagreement over the floor can make honest proposers build competing branches
Builders must reserve the full target up front, favouring those with more capital
